original_query: Serrano와 Smith의 attention 제거, Michel 등의 head 제거·유지, Dynamic Convolution의 최대 가중치 kernel 선택은 각각 무엇을 시험했으며, 우리의 post-fusion instance normalization을 통과하는 두 branch 제거 정책의 finite-epsilon 분석과 어떻게 다른가?
english_query: What do attention removal by Serrano and Smith, head removal and retention by Michel et al., and maximum-weight kernel selection in Dynamic Convolution each test, and how do they differ from our finite-epsilon analysis of two branch-removal policies followed by post-fusion instance normalization?

required_conditions.english: Identify the manipulated unit and whether the intervention removes, retains, or selects the maximum-weight component in a trained system.
Verify whether surviving coefficients are renormalized and which subsequent operators the source actually studies; leave unspecified details unresolved.
Distinguish the source's reported functional endpoint from the per-channel finite-epsilon comparison of paired removal policies in a spatial kernel mixture.
